description: This file defines a NotificationManager class for handling calendar event notifications in an Android app. It creates notification channels for API level 26 (Oreo) and higher, and provides a method to display notifications for calendar events.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and displaying notifications for calendar events within the app.

methods.name: createNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel for API 26+ devices to categorize notifications for calendar events.

methods.name: showEventNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification for a given calendar event.
